evaluations.note: Raised 20 -> 23 when the journal's evaluation census was fixed (D3). record_eval() used to run only on the success path, so the three evaluations that exit through the StagnationStop catch -- one per RESTART decision -- were never counted. loss.tadah always contained all 23 rows; only the counter was short. The run itself is unchanged: the MPI determinism signature and every other fingerprint in the bundle are bit-identical.

tolerance_rationale: Bundle is bit-deterministic when SEED is set; tolerances absorb cross-machine BLAS/LAPACK reorder and FP printf rounding while still flagging a material regression.
